title: Circuit Book launches
summary: A personal library of workouts and drills, routines set to days of the week, and a full-screen session mode that walks you through them one station at a time.
details: Library: each exercise entered once, with photos and a target.
Routines set to weekdays; Today shows what's due.
Session mode records each tap, and taps made without a signal sync when it's back.
History of every session, with Resume for unfinished ones.
Installs to the home screen; each person's data is private to their account.

title: Blocks: straight sets, supersets and circuits
summary: Routines are built from blocks. One exercise is straight sets, two alternate as a superset, three or more run as a circuit, and every set is ticked on its own.
details: Done ticks the next set, or the whole round in a superset or circuit.
Any set square can be tapped to tick or untick it out of order.
Existing routines and logged sessions were carried over unchanged.

title: Photo sequences
summary: An exercise can hold several photos in order. Tap to step through them in a session, or play them on a loop.

title: Target muscles and body map
summary: Mark the muscles an exercise works on a body map. The library filters by muscle, and each routine shows what it covers.

title: In-app Guide
summary: Every screen explained with annotated screenshots, plus offline tips and answers to common questions. Open it from the ? button.

title: Fixes to Swap, deleting exercises and Today
summary: A handful of fixes found while writing the Guide.
details: Swapping an exercise now clears its ticked sets everywhere; they used to come back on Resume.
Deleting an exercise removes any block it was alone in, instead of leaving an empty one.
The exercise editor no longer stays greyed out after a delete.
Today counted exercises but called them sets; it now shows the real set count.

title: Getting-started tour
summary: A swipeable, slide-by-slide walk through every screen. It opens once on a new device, and you can replay it from the top of the Guide.

title: Guide screenshots rebuild themselves
summary: Every push re-takes the Guide and tour screenshots from the real app on demo data, and fails if a screen is missing from either.
details: First automatic refresh committed by the workflow the same day.

title: What's new
summary: When an update changes something you use, a summary like this one appears the first time you open the app afterwards. It only lists changes that apply to you.

title: Admin change log
summary: Admins get a full history of every change to Circuit Book, filterable and exportable as JSON or CSV. Find it under Admin at the bottom of History.

title: Admin role and new domain set up
summary: Added an admin role, held in each account's app metadata (cb_role), and attached circuitbook.mkcworkspace.com to the Vercel project. The new address goes live once its DNS record is added at GoDaddy.
details: Admins: set with SQL by someone with database access; see the README.
Users can't change their own role.

title: New address: circuitbook.mkcworkspace.com
summary: Circuit Book now lives at circuitbook.mkcworkspace.com. The old address sends you here automatically.
details: Sign in once on the new address with your usual email and password. Your routines, library and history are all here.
If you added Circuit Book to your Home Screen, add it again from the new address and remove the old icon.

title: Sign-up emails link back to Circuit Book
summary: The confirmation link in a new account's email now opens Circuit Book at the address the person signed up on.
